name: com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp.tilemap
description: MCP Tools for Tilemap - Enhance your Unity projects with AI-powered 2D Tilemap tools using the MCP framework. Create Grid + Tilemap hierarchies, paint and box-fill tiles, read/clear tiles, set tile color and transform flags, build Tile and RuleTile assets, and configure TilemapRenderer/orientation via natural language.
